page.overview:
Who is Eagle?

When enters a licensing office to apply for a passport, the receptionist, who is revealed to be 's mother, informs him that he and his friends will need a work license as a requirement to obtain the passport. Then, 's mother suggests to go see his son, who she calls "Shīshī-chan," and ask him for a job.

When meets , he will not pay attention, however, once calls him Shīshī-chan, he will get embarrassed and processed to help if he keeps that name as a secret. After that, will give a memo which contains a riddle. When the riddle is solved, it will lead to a secret agent, where he is given another riddle.

As part of a , returns to . There, the receptionist will ask him to help find a job. To do this, he must speak to the old tree on and obtain his sapling. When he gives it to , he will plant it in the city park and succeed in growing it, rewarding with a .
